bourse-d-excellence-eiffel.title: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship
bourse-d-excellence-eiffel.summary: Funds outstanding international students for a master's degree or a PhD at a French institution. The application is submitted by the host institution.
eligibility: The French institution submits your application: first contact the international relations office of the master's programme you are aiming for.

daad-study-scholarships-for-graduates.title: DAAD Study Scholarships for Graduates
daad-study-scholarships-for-graduates.summary: Scholarship for a full master's degree or one year of study in Germany, open to bachelor's graduates in all fields.

daad-epos-masters-lies-au-developpement.title: DAAD EPOS: Development-Related Postgraduate Courses
daad-epos-masters-lies-au-developpement.summary: Master's and PhD programmes in Germany in fields that support development (economics, public health, engineering, environment) for professionals from developing countries with two years of experience.

daad-research-grants-doctorat-en-allemag.title: DAAD Research Grants: Doctoral Programmes in Germany
daad-research-grants-doctorat-en-allemag.summary: Funds a full PhD or a doctoral research stay in Germany for young international researchers.

chevening-scholarships.title: Chevening Scholarships
chevening-scholarships.summary: A fully funded one-year master's degree in the United Kingdom for future leaders with at least two years of work experience.
eligibility: At least two years (2,800 hours) of work experience.
Applications submitted to three eligible master's programmes in the United Kingdom.
Commitment to return to your home country for at least two years after the scholarship.

documents_detail.lettre: Four short online essays (leadership, networking, study choices, career plan), 500 words each.

commonwealth-shared-scholarships.title: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships
commonwealth-shared-scholarships.summary: A one-year master's degree in the United Kingdom on development topics, for students from low and middle income Commonwealth countries.

programme-fulbright-pour-etudiants-etran.title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
programme-fulbright-pour-etudiants-etran.summary: Master's or PhD in the United States. Applications go through the Fulbright commission or the US embassy in your home country, with a calendar specific to each country.

bourse-du-gouvernement-japonais-mext.title: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship
bourse-du-gouvernement-japonais-mext.summary: Fully funded bachelor's, master's or PhD studies in Japan. Selection by the Embassy of Japan or recommendation by a Japanese university.
eligibility: Pass the written tests and interview organised by the Embassy of Japan.

bourse-du-gouvernement-chinois-csc.title: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC)
bourse-du-gouvernement-chinois-csc.summary: Full study programmes in China from bachelor's to PhD level, covering tuition, accommodation and a monthly stipend.

stipendium-hungaricum.title: Stipendium Hungaricum
stipendium-hungaricum.summary: Bachelor's, master's or PhD studies in Hungary for nationals of partner countries, covering tuition, accommodation and a stipend.

turkiye-burslar.title: Türkiye Scholarships
turkiye-burslar.summary: Full scholarship for bachelor's, master's or PhD studies in Türkiye, with a preparatory year of Turkish.

bourses-erasmus-mundus-masters-conjoints.title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's Scholarships
bourses-erasmus-mundus-masters-conjoints.summary: Joint master's programmes in at least two European countries. Each consortium awards its own full scholarships, and the deadline depends on the programme chosen.

mastercard-foundation-scholars-program.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
mastercard-foundation-scholars-program.summary: Full scholarships for talented young Africans from low-income backgrounds, for bachelor's or master's studies at partner universities in Africa and beyond.
eligibility: Show limited financial means and a commitment to your community.

bourses-de-mobilite-de-l-auf.title: AUF Mobility Grants
bourses-de-mobilite-de-l-auf.summary: Master's and PhD mobility between AUF member universities, for students and researchers in the French-speaking world. Calls are published by region.

bourses-de-la-banque-mondiale-jj-wbgsp.title: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP)
bourses-de-la-banque-mondiale-jj-wbgsp.summary: Development-related master's programmes at partner universities, for professionals from developing countries with experience in the field.

bourses-d-etudes-superieures-du-canada-v.title: Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships
bourses-d-etudes-superieures-du-canada-v.summary: PhD studies at a Canadian university for outstanding candidates nominated by their university.

bourses-d-excellence-de-la-confederation.title: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships
bourses-d-excellence-de-la-confederation.summary: PhD, research or postdoctoral studies at a Swiss university for international researchers. Each country has its own calendar.

actions-marie-sk-odowska-curie-reseaux-d.title: Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions: Doctoral Networks
actions-marie-sk-odowska-curie-reseaux-d.summary: Doctoral contracts in European research networks, open to all nationalities subject to a mobility rule.

bourses-du-gouvernement-francais-bgf.title: French Government Scholarships (BGF)
bourses-du-gouvernement-francais-bgf.summary: Scholarships awarded by French embassies for a master's degree or a PhD in France, with criteria and calendars specific to each country.

bourses-d-excellence-major-aefe.title: AEFE Excellence-Major Scholarships
bourses-d-excellence-major-aefe.summary: For the best international graduates of French high schools abroad who continue their higher education in France.

bourse-sur-criteres-sociaux-crous.title: Need-Based Grant (Crous)
bourse-sur-criteres-sociaux-crous.summary: Financial support for students in France from low-income families, requested through the student social file (DSE).

bourse-erasmus-de-mobilite-etudiante.title: Erasmus+ Student Mobility Grant
bourse-erasmus-de-mobilite-etudiante.summary: Support for a semester or a year of study in another European country during your bachelor's or master's degree, through your university.

gates-cambridge-scholarship.title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
gates-cambridge-scholarship.summary: A full scholarship for a master's degree or a PhD at the University of Cambridge, for students from outside the United Kingdom committed to improving the lives of others.

australia-awards-scholarships.title: Australia Awards Scholarships
australia-awards-scholarships.summary: Master's studies in Australia for nationals of developing partner countries, who commit to returning to contribute to their country.

global-korea-scholarship-gks.title: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS)
global-korea-scholarship-gks.summary: Bachelor's, master's or PhD studies in South Korea, with one year of Korean language, tuition and a monthly stipend.

prix-jeunes-talents-l-oreal-unesco-pour-.title: L'Oréal-UNESCO For Women in Science Young Talents Programme (Sub-Saharan Africa)
prix-jeunes-talents-l-oreal-unesco-pour-.summary: Rewards and supports African women PhD students and postdoctoral researchers in science.

holland-scholarship.title: Holland Scholarship
holland-scholarship.summary: First-year funding for students from outside the European Economic Area starting a bachelor's or master's degree in the Netherlands.

bourses-emile-boutmy-sciences-po.title: Émile-Boutmy Scholarships (Sciences Po)
bourses-emile-boutmy-sciences-po.summary: For the best international students from outside the European Union admitted to a bachelor's or master's programme at Sciences Po.

mandela-rhodes-scholarship.title: Mandela Rhodes Scholarship
mandela-rhodes-scholarship.summary: Master's studies in South Africa for young Africans with strong leadership potential, with an accompanying leadership programme.

aga-khan-foundation-international-schola.title: Aga Khan Foundation International Scholarship Programme
aga-khan-foundation-international-schola.summary: A loan-scholarship for a master's degree abroad for outstanding students from developing countries who have no other means of funding.

bourses-d-exemption-des-droits-de-scolar.title: Differential Tuition Fee Exemption Scholarships (Quebec universities)
bourses-d-exemption-des-droits-de-scolar.summary: Exemption from the higher international tuition fees for students from partner countries enrolled at a Quebec university.

swedish-institute-scholarships-for-globa.title: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals
swedish-institute-scholarships-for-globa.summary: A one- or two-year master's degree in Sweden for professionals from eligible countries who want to contribute to sustainable development in their country.
eligibility: At least 3,000 hours of work experience (paid or voluntary).
First be admitted to an eligible master's programme through universityadmissions.se.

documents_detail.recommandation: Two professional references using the Swedish Institute template.
documents_detail.cv: A CV in the Europass format is recommended.

bourses-des-universites-de-finlande-finl.title: Finland Scholarship (Finnish universities)
bourses-des-universites-de-finlande-finl.summary: Finnish universities waive all or part of the tuition fees for the best bachelor's and master's students from outside the European Union.

bourses-du-gouvernement-danois.title: Danish Government Scholarships
bourses-du-gouvernement-danois.summary: Tuition waivers and a stipend for highly qualified students from outside the European Union, awarded by Danish universities.

bourses-ares-de-la-cooperation-belge.title: ARES Scholarships (Belgian development cooperation)
bourses-ares-de-la-cooperation-belge.summary: Specialised master's programmes and short courses in French-speaking Belgium for professionals from partner countries of Belgian cooperation, including many African countries.
eligibility: At least two years of work experience in the field of the master's programme.
Live and work in a partner country at the time of application.

bourses-vlir-uos-masters-en-flandre.title: VLIR-UOS Scholarships (master's programmes in Flanders)
bourses-vlir-uos-masters-en-flandre.summary: International master's programmes taught in English at Flemish universities, linked to sustainable development, for candidates from developing countries.

master-mind-scholarships-flandre.title: Master Mind Scholarships (Flanders)
master-mind-scholarships-flandre.summary: Excellence scholarships for international students starting a bachelor's or master's degree at a Flemish institution.

bourses-de-la-fondation-heinrich-boll.title: Heinrich Böll Foundation Scholarships
bourses-de-la-fondation-heinrich-boll.summary: Master's and PhD scholarships in Germany for committed students (ecology, democracy, human rights), including international students.
eligibility: Be enrolled at or admitted to a German university.
Show social or political commitment.

deutschlandstipendium.title: Deutschlandstipendium
deutschlandstipendium.summary: A scholarship of €300 per month paid by German universities to high-achieving students of any nationality.

bourses-ernst-mach-oead.title: Ernst Mach Grants (OeAD)
bourses-ernst-mach-oead.summary: Research and study stays in Austria for advanced students and PhD candidates from developing countries.

bourses-du-gouvernement-italien-maeci.title: Italian Government Scholarships (MAECI)
bourses-du-gouvernement-italien-maeci.summary: Scholarships for master's, PhD and research programmes at Italian universities, open to international students.

becas-maec-aecid-espagne.title: MAEC-AECID Scholarships (Spain)
becas-maec-aecid-espagne.summary: Master's and PhD scholarships in Spain for students from Latin America, Africa and the Arab world, according to the annual calls.

bourses-ignacy-ukasiewicz-nawa-pologne.title: Ignacy Łukasiewicz Scholarships (NAWA, Poland)
bourses-ignacy-ukasiewicz-nawa-pologne.summary: Master's programmes in Poland, taught in English or Polish, for students from developing countries in fields that support development.

quota-du-gouvernement-russe.title: Russian Government Quota Scholarships
quota-du-gouvernement-russe.summary: Tuition-free places at Russian universities from bachelor's to PhD level, with a preparatory year of Russian if needed.

rhodes-scholarship-universite-d-oxford.title: Rhodes Scholarship (University of Oxford)
rhodes-scholarship-universite-d-oxford.summary: Fully funded master's or PhD studies at Oxford for young leaders from around the world (selection by constituency).
eligibility: Age and nationality rules depend on the Rhodes constituency (for example West Africa or Southern Africa).

clarendon-scholarships-oxford.title: Clarendon Scholarships (Oxford)
clarendon-scholarships-oxford.summary: Full scholarships for outstanding graduates admitted to a master's or PhD programme at Oxford; you are considered automatically when you apply for admission.

great-scholarships-british-council.title: GREAT Scholarships (British Council)
great-scholarships-british-council.summary: £10,000 towards a one-year master's degree in the United Kingdom, reserved for students from selected countries (including Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, Egypt, India and Pakistan).

irish-aid-fellowship-training-programme.title: Irish Aid Fellowship Training Programme
irish-aid-fellowship-training-programme.summary: A one-year master's degree in Ireland for professionals from partner countries of Irish development cooperation in Africa and Asia.
eligibility: Work for a public administration, an NGO or a development organisation.
Commit to returning to work in your home country.

eth-excellence-scholarship-zurich.title: ETH Excellence Scholarship (Zurich)
eth-excellence-scholarship-zurich.summary: A full scholarship for the best students admitted to a master's programme at ETH Zurich, regardless of nationality.

hubert-h-humphrey-fellowship.title: Hubert H. Humphrey Fellowship
hubert-h-humphrey-fellowship.summary: A year of professional development in the United States for mid-career professionals, without a degree but with university courses and a placement.
eligibility: At least five years of full-time work experience.
No recent study in the United States lasting more than six months.

knight-hennessy-scholars-stanford.title: Knight-Hennessy Scholars (Stanford)
knight-hennessy-scholars-stanford.summary: Full funding for any master's or PhD degree at Stanford, with a leadership programme, for candidates from around the world.
eligibility: Bachelor's degree obtained less than seven years ago.
Also apply to a Stanford graduate programme.

aauw-international-fellowships.title: AAUW International Fellowships
aauw-international-fellowships.summary: Fellowships for women who are not US citizens pursuing a full-time master's degree or PhD in the United States.

bourses-postdoctorales-banting.title: Banting Postdoctoral Fellowships
bourses-postdoctorales-banting.summary: CAD 70,000 per year for two years for top postdoctoral researchers at a Canadian institution.

bourses-lester-b-pearson-universite-de-t.title: Lester B. Pearson International Scholarships (University of Toronto)
bourses-lester-b-pearson-universite-de-t.summary: A full four-year undergraduate scholarship at the University of Toronto for exceptional international students nominated by their school.

programme-de-bourses-de-l-oea.title: OAS Academic Scholarship Program
programme-de-bourses-de-l-oea.summary: Master's and PhD scholarships in OAS member states, reserved for nationals of the Americas.

bourses-du-gouvernement-mexicain-amexcid.title: Mexican Government Scholarships (AMEXCID)
bourses-du-gouvernement-mexicain-amexcid.summary: A monthly stipend and health insurance for international students admitted to a master's, PhD or research programme at a Mexican university.

programme-pec-pg-bresil.title: PEC-PG Programme (Brazil)
programme-pec-pg-bresil.summary: Master's and PhD scholarships in Brazil for nationals of developing countries that have an agreement with Brazil, including many African countries.

bourses-agcid-chili.title: AGCID Scholarships (Chile)
bourses-agcid-chili.summary: Master's programmes in Chile for professionals from Latin America and the Caribbean.

singapore-international-graduate-award-s.title: Singapore International Graduate Award (SINGA)
singapore-international-graduate-award-s.summary: A fully funded four-year PhD in Singapore in science and engineering for international students.

malaysia-international-scholarship-mis.title: Malaysia International Scholarship (MIS)
malaysia-international-scholarship-mis.summary: Master's or PhD studies at a Malaysian public university for international students from selected countries.

bourses-du-gouvernement-thailandais-tica.title: Thai Government Scholarships (TICA)
bourses-du-gouvernement-thailandais-tica.summary: Master's programmes in Thailand for civil servants and professionals from partner countries in Asia, Africa and Latin America.

bourse-du-gouvernement-de-brunei.title: Brunei Darussalam Government Scholarship
bourse-du-gouvernement-de-brunei.summary: Fully funded bachelor's or master's studies at universities in Brunei for selected international students.

taiwan-scholarship.title: Taiwan Scholarship
taiwan-scholarship.summary: Bachelor's, master's or PhD studies in Taiwan with tuition and a monthly stipend; apply through the Taipei representative office.

bourses-icdf-taiwan.title: ICDF Scholarships (Taiwan)
bourses-icdf-taiwan.summary: English-taught bachelor's, master's and PhD programmes in Taiwan for nationals of Taiwan's development cooperation partner countries.

schwarzman-scholars-pekin.title: Schwarzman Scholars (Beijing)
schwarzman-scholars-pekin.summary: A fully funded one-year master's degree in global affairs at Tsinghua University in Beijing for future leaders.

yenching-academy-universite-de-pekin.title: Yenching Academy (Peking University)
yenching-academy-universite-de-pekin.summary: A fully funded interdisciplinary master's degree in China studies at Peking University, open to all nationalities.

jds-bourses-de-developpement-des-ressour.title: JDS: Project for Human Resource Development Scholarship (Japan)
jds-bourses-de-developpement-des-ressour.summary: A master's degree in Japan, taught in English, for young civil servants from partner countries in Asia and Africa.
eligibility: Be a civil servant or public employee in your country (according to the list of target organisations).

iccr-bourses-pour-l-afrique-et-les-pays-.title: ICCR Scholarships for Africa and Partner Countries (India)
iccr-bourses-pour-l-afrique-et-les-pays-.summary: Bachelor's, master's or PhD studies in India, covering tuition, accommodation and a stipend, for students from African and partner countries.

bourses-d-etudes-en-arabie-saoudite-stud.title: Study in Saudi Arabia Scholarships
bourses-d-etudes-en-arabie-saoudite-stud.summary: Tuition-free studies from bachelor's to PhD level at Saudi universities, with accommodation, a stipend and a flight ticket.

kaust-fellowship.title: KAUST Fellowship
kaust-fellowship.summary: Fully funded master's and PhD studies in science and engineering at KAUST, with a stipend and accommodation.

bourses-de-l-universite-khalifa-abou-dha.title: Khalifa University Scholarships (Abu Dhabi)
bourses-de-l-universite-khalifa-abou-dha.summary: Master's and PhD studies in engineering and science in Abu Dhabi, with a tuition waiver and a monthly stipend.

bourses-de-l-universite-hamad-bin-khalif.title: Hamad Bin Khalifa University Scholarships (Qatar)
bourses-de-l-universite-hamad-bin-khalif.summary: Master's and PhD programmes in Qatar with scholarships covering tuition and a stipend for admitted students.

bourses-de-la-banque-islamique-de-develo.title: Islamic Development Bank Scholarships
bourses-de-la-banque-islamique-de-develo.summary: Bachelor's, master's and PhD studies for nationals of IsDB member countries, especially in science, engineering and medicine.

programme-de-bourses-adb-japon.title: ADB-Japan Scholarship Program
programme-de-bourses-adb-japon.summary: A master's degree at a partner university in Asia and the Pacific for nationals of ADB developing member countries.

bourses-manaaki-new-zealand.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
bourses-manaaki-new-zealand.summary: Bachelor's, master's or PhD studies in New Zealand for nationals of eligible countries in Africa, Asia, the Pacific and Latin America.
eligibility: At least two years of work experience for master's programmes (depending on the country).
Commit to returning to your home country after your studies.

research-training-program-australie.title: Research Training Program (Australia)
research-training-program-australie.summary: Research PhDs and master's degrees in Australia, with tuition covered and a stipend, awarded by each university.

bourses-de-l-universite-panafricaine-pau.title: Pan African University Scholarships (PAU)
bourses-de-l-universite-panafricaine-pau.summary: Fully funded master's and PhD programmes at the institutes of the Pan African University (Cameroon, Kenya, Nigeria, Algeria) for African students.
eligibility: Study at an institute located outside your home country.

master-aims-en-sciences-mathematiques.title: AIMS Master's in Mathematical Sciences
master-aims-en-sciences-mathematiques.summary: A fully funded one-year structured master's degree in mathematical sciences at AIMS centres (Senegal, Ghana, Cameroon, Rwanda, South Africa).

bourses-de-cooperation-marocaine-amci.title: Moroccan Cooperation Scholarships (AMCI)
bourses-de-cooperation-marocaine-amci.summary: Tuition-free studies in Morocco from bachelor's to PhD level, with a stipend, for students from partner countries nominated by their government.
eligibility: Applications go through the ministry or scholarship office of your country, which forwards the files to AMCI.

bourses-um6p-pour-etudiants-africains.title: UM6P Scholarships for African Students
bourses-um6p-pour-etudiants-africains.summary: Scholarships covering all or part of tuition and accommodation for African students admitted to UM6P, from bachelor's to PhD level.

daad-in-country-in-region-afrique-subsah.title: DAAD In-Country/In-Region Scholarships (Sub-Saharan Africa)
daad-in-country-in-region-afrique-subsah.summary: Master's and PhD scholarships at an African university in your own country or region, funded by Germany.

opec-fund-scholarship-program.title: OPEC Fund Scholarship Program
opec-fund-scholarship-program.summary: A full scholarship for a master's degree abroad for students from developing countries, in development-related fields.

programme-de-stages-des-nations-unies.title: United Nations Internship Programme
programme-de-stages-des-nations-unies.summary: Internships of two to six months at UN Headquarters (New York, Geneva, Vienna, Nairobi) and in the regional commissions, for master's or PhD students.
eligibility: Be enrolled in a master's or PhD programme, or in the final year of a bachelor's degree.
Be fluent in English or French.

documents_detail.cv: A complete profile on the Inspira / careers.un.org portal (UN form, not a free-format CV).

bank-internship-program-banque-mondiale.title: Bank Internship Program (World Bank)
bank-internship-program-banque-mondiale.summary: A paid internship of at least four weeks in Washington or in a country office, for master's or PhD students.

fund-internship-program-fmi.title: Fund Internship Program (IMF)
fund-internship-program-fmi.summary: A paid summer internship of ten to twelve weeks at the IMF for PhD and master's students in economics, finance or statistics.

stages-blue-book-de-la-commission-europe.title: European Commission Blue Book Traineeships
stages-blue-book-de-la-commission-europe.summary: A paid five-month traineeship at the European Commission (Brussels, Luxembourg), open to graduates of all nationalities.
eligibility: Hold at least a bachelor's degree (3 years of study) by the deadline.
Speak two European languages, including English, French or German.

stages-schuman-au-parlement-europeen.title: Schuman Traineeships at the European Parliament
stages-schuman-au-parlement-europeen.summary: A paid five-month traineeship at the European Parliament for graduates, including from outside the European Union (limited places).

programme-de-stages-de-la-banque-africai.title: African Development Bank Internship Programme
programme-de-stages-de-la-banque-africai.summary: Internships of three to six months at AfDB headquarters in Abidjan for master's or PhD students from member countries.

stages-a-la-commission-de-l-union-africa.title: African Union Commission Internships
stages-a-la-commission-de-l-union-africa.summary: Internships in Addis Ababa and in African Union organs for young African graduates.

stages-de-l-unicef.title: UNICEF Internships
stages-de-l-unicef.summary: Internships of six weeks to six months in UNICEF offices around the world, often with a stipend.

stages-de-l-organisation-mondiale-de-la-.title: World Health Organization Internships
stages-de-l-organisation-mondiale-de-la-.summary: Internships of six to twenty-four weeks at WHO (Geneva and regional offices, including Brazzaville) for students in health and related fields.

volontariat-international-de-la-francoph.title: International Francophonie Volunteer Programme
volontariat-international-de-la-francoph.summary: Twelve-month assignments for young people aged 21 to 34 from French-speaking countries, in another country of the Francophonie, with an allowance.

deep-learning-indaba.title: Deep Learning Indaba
deep-learning-indaba.summary: The major annual artificial intelligence gathering in Africa: lectures, workshops and posters, with travel covered for many selected students.

data-science-africa.title: Data Science Africa
data-science-africa.summary: An annual workshop and conference on data science and machine learning in Africa, with participation grants.

one-young-world-summit.title: One Young World Summit
one-young-world-summit.summary: A global summit for young leaders (aged 18 to 30); full participation scholarships are offered to delegates from developing countries.

forum-de-la-jeunesse-de-l-ecosoc-onu.title: ECOSOC Youth Forum (United Nations)
forum-de-la-jeunesse-de-l-ecosoc-onu.summary: An annual forum at UN Headquarters where young people engage with governments on the Sustainable Development Goals; online participation is possible.

women-deliver-conference.title: Women Deliver Conference
women-deliver-conference.summary: An international conference on gender equality and health; a scholarship programme funds the attendance of young participants.

youthconnekt-africa-summit.title: YouthConnekt Africa Summit
youthconnekt-africa-summit.summary: A pan-African summit on youth employment and entrepreneurship, with workshops, project competitions and investor meetings.
